title: devstuff links catalog
description: Schema for links.yaml (bundled at src/dev_setup/links.yaml, user overrides at ~/.config/devstuff/links.yaml). Defines bookmarks to other tools' sites and docs, listed, searched, and opened via `devstuff links`. Mirrors the validation in links_catalog.py — keep both in sync.

links.description: Map of link key -> link definition.

propertyNames.description: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, underscores; must start with a letter or digit.

name.description: Title shown in listings and matched by `links search`. Defaults to the catalog key.

description.description: Short description shown in listings and matched by `links search`. Defaults to an empty string.

category.description: Freeform grouping label used by `links list`. Defaults to 'custom'.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL opened in the browser. Other schemes (file:, javascript:, ...) are rejected.
